test_objective: Verify throwing 415 HTTP status code (Unsupported Media Type) if "Content-Type" header is not "application/json" or "application/ld+json"

test_cases.name: 044_03_01 endpoint patch /entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attrId}
test_cases.doc: Verify throwing 415 HTTP status code (Unsupported Media Type) if "Content-Type" header is not "application/json" or "application/ld+json" (patch /entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attrId})
test_cases.teardown: Delete Entity by Id Returning Response
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Request Partial Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: entityId set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: AttributeId set to 'speed' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-brandname-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/xml'
}
